note: Small fishing camp on Portage Bay at the north end of Leech Lake, with a harbor of floating docks, a boat launch and a shallow beach. Many sites are seasonal; primitive tent sites and a few lake-view sites too. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: daily E/W/Dock $37, E/W/S/Dock $40, $5 extra person over 4 (rates page still titled 2019); water/sewer confirmed; booking by phone (set); store and wifi set; showers/laundry/dump/pull-through cleared (directory-derived, operator silent). Google 4.8/4, RV Life 4*/$$. Mostly-seasonal look on imagery; long-stay tests need a reviewer. Pin OK.
flags: Price: the only posted rates are on a page titled 'Camping & Lodging Rates – 2019' ($37/$40 a night, $249/$270 a week). No 2024+ operator rate exists. It passes the price leg only on RV Life's $$ tier, which does not stand in if the park is judged long-stay in character.

Long-stay tests: (1) nightly stays are sold ('We take reservations for nightly, weekly, or even monthly stays.'); (2) the nightly price is posted but dated 2019; (3) no wording discourages nightly guests; (4) the nightly share is unmeasured: the operator gives no site counts, and leaf-on imagery shows about 20-25 RVs, most with decks, sheds or additions in the look of seasonal setups, plus cabins/houses; seasonal sites 'may be occupied from May 1 thru October 1' with metered electric; (5) presence: an operator website with phone 218-654-3785 (Google has only 4 reviews). Reviewer to judge whether it is mostly seasonal.
Google: 4.8 from 4 reviews (under 25, no review-based drop). RV Life 4*/$$ (stored 2026-06).

Season: the home page says 'New Leech Lake Campground is open year round for summer and winter ice fishing, hunting, snowmobiling and ATVing.' That may reflect the lodge apartments/ice-fishing lodging rather than RV sites with water; season left unset.

Waterfront: operator says 'we have a few sites with a lake view'; imagery shows a few RVs around the dredged harbor basin about 20-40 m from its channel. No site numbers or nightly/seasonal split published, so not waterfront kept; at most a lakeview lead.
ATV: the home page lists ATVing among winter activities; a general campground with an OHV side, flag only.
Pets are $10 a night each (rates page); extra vehicles/boats not allowed on camp sites.
Phone 218-654-3785 confirmed. Website http://www.leechlakecampground.com/ confirmed (HTTP only).
